video_title: Brook Lopez Press Conference | LA Clippers Media Day 2026

quotes.speaker: Brook Lopez
quotes.text: We are still trying to win, still trying to be competitive. We see the ultimate goal of winning a championship. I think the mix of vets and youth that you mentioned is a huge positive for us. I think we got just the right mix of that and it is going to be a very exciting year and a lot of opportunities for people to step up.
quotes.news_angle: Brook Lopez says the Clippers are focused on winning a championship this season.
quotes.social_post: Brook Lopez says the Clippers are focused on winning a championship this season, noting that the team has the right mix of veterans and young players to be competitive.

quotes.speaker: Brook Lopez
quotes.text: With the way the team is built now, I definitely see myself playing in the paint a ton more, posting up, being a low post scoring threat, and basing my game around that a lot more than just sitting on the perimeter. Whatever I have to do to be big out there. I know we do not have the biggest lineup necessarily at all times, so I want to do my part of being big when I am on the court.
quotes.news_angle: Brook Lopez plans to play more in the paint this season.
quotes.social_post: Brook Lopez says he plans to play more in the paint and be a low post scoring threat this season to help the Clippers.

quotes.speaker: Brook Lopez
quotes.text: I want to be better at everything. I always want to be a better player, but I think just more dominant in the paint, more of an anchor point there offensively, get better in our defensive system here, be more aggressive defensively in the pick and roll, protecting the rim, rebounding the ball more. Whatever I have to do to be big out there. I know we do not have the biggest lineup necessarily at all times, so I want to do my part of being big when I am on the court.
quotes.news_angle: Brook Lopez aims to be more dominant in the paint and improve defensively.
quotes.social_post: Brook Lopez says he wants to be more dominant in the paint and improve his defensive impact for the Clippers this season.
